ʘ_ʘ.definition: The [expression] you get, when a nigger is asked to work, asked to count to 10, asked to stay [off of] drugs, or speak [proper English]
ʘ_ʘ.example:
[Nigger]: "Niggaa Beeyoom buu buu pathaww!"
[Educated] man: "[Speak English] you black turd slave!"
Nigger: "Wha, Yuu no understan mee?" ʘ_ʘ
